harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured split DNS on node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) so each router resolves app.internal to the service address on its own side. node1 uses `service dns forwarding` + a static-host-mapping for app.internal -> 10.100.13.12 (node3). node2 uses an Unbound host override (hostname=app, domain=internal, rr=A, server=10.100.13.13, i.e. node4). Verified end-to-end from node3 (querying node1) and node4 (querying node2). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all four nodes, proving boot-identity change and post-restart recovery of DNS/config/network state on each.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (VyOS 2026.04 rolling), node2 (OPNsense/FreeBSD 14.3), node3 and node4 (Alpine) topology and baseline config
Configured VyOS node1: static-host-mapping app.internal -> 10.100.13.12, dns forwarding listen-address/allow-from, committed and saved
Diagnosed and fixed OPNsense unbound host-override XML schema (hostname/domain/rr/server/description, not host/domain/ip) after an initial malformed entry broke unbound
Restarted unbound via configctl unbound restart and verified host_entries.conf and live DNS resolution on node2
Cross-verified resolution from node3 (via node1) and node4 (via node2)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/kern.boottime and DNS-answer baselines on all 4 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 sequentially (one at a time) using native reboot/shutdown -r now, polling until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot identity on all 4 nodes post-restart
Re-verified DNS service state, interface addressing, and correct split-DNS answers on all nodes after their respective restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 (lan-a router) resolves app.internal to node3's address
evidence.summary: VyOS config committed/saved (static-host-mapping + dns forwarding); dig from node1 itself and nslookup from node3 both return 10.100.13.12

evidence.requirement: node2 (lan-b router) resolves app.internal to node4's address
evidence.summary: Fixed unbound host-override schema, restarted unbound, host_entries.conf shows correct local-data, drill from node2 and nslookup from node4 both return 10.100.13.13
boot_id=7668189d... captured; dns answer 10.100.13.12 confirmed working pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect, boot_id changed to 181bfe2c after polling, pdns_recursor listening again on 10.100.13.10:53, config persisted (static-host-mapping present), node3 resolves app.internal correctly post-restart
kern.boottime sec=1788669925 captured; drill answer 10.100.13.13 confirmed working pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now acknowledged, boottime changed to sec=1788670236 after polling, unbound process running again, drill and node4 nslookup both confirm app.internal -> 10.100.13.13 post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id=4fe6dc15 and working DNS captured; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to b9a6f079 after polling through connection resets/timeouts; interface re-acquired 10.100.13.12 and DNS query to node1 still resolves correctly

evidence.requirement: node4 healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id=b296435a and working DNS captured; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 253b0f4d after polling; interface re-acquired 10.100.13.13 and DNS query to node2 still resolves correctly

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end confirmation of split-DNS behavior after all four restarts
evidence.summary: Post-restart, node3 via node1 and node4 via node2 each still resolve app.internal to their own side's service address
